QUOTE: "The argument side is built by `args_to_pattern` (`server_manager.cpp:426`), which takes the value of the first string argument, or `*` if there is none."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states only one argument value (the first string argument) is used in the pattern and that a call with no string argument falls back to `*`, which covers the wildcard-collapse part. Ignoring the other arguments is implied by "first string argument".
